evidence_before_training.interpretation: The former full-image SoftRas-style alpha is not a trustworthy forward coverage objective for a highly tessellated surface: each foreground pixel can be close to internal triangle edges. This differs materially from silhouette antialias semantics.

replacement_raster_loss.formula: alpha_ste = hard.detach() + soft - soft.detach(); loss is class-balanced |alpha_ste-target| only inside the detached boundary/hole band
replacement_raster_loss.rationale: Forward loss now measures actual mesh coverage rather than internal-triangle softness; backward remains differentiable near geometry boundaries.

proxy_gate.purpose: Prove the 256-grid training surface is a sufficiently faithful proxy for the frozen-C product mesh before any update. Failure is apparatus mismatch, not scientific negative.

mesh_grid.reason: Do not add a second causal change until hard proxy parity is measured. If the preregistered proxy gate fails, escalate carrier resolution in a new amendment rather than training against a known-mismatched proxy.
